nodes.description: mapping(address=>mapping(uint256=>uint256)) public rewards; per-user per-collection accrued rewards
mapping(address=>mapping(uint256=>uint256)) public lastUpdate; last timestamp reward was settled for a user/collection
mapping(uint256=>CollectionInfo) public collectionInfo; name/boostCap/hardCap per collection
mapping(uint256=>uint256) public totalSupplyByCollection; total minted per collection
mapping(uint256=>uint256) public remainingBoostByCollection; boost budget left per collection
mapping(uint256=>uint256) public remainingSupplyByCollection; mintable supply left per collection
ISpaceCows public spaceCows; external NFT contract used for minting rate lookups
initialize(string,string) public initializer; sets ERC20 metadata and mints initial liquidity supply to msg.sender
external updateUserTimeOnMint(address,uint256) guarded by isAllowAddress; stores block.timestamp for user/collection
internal updateUserTime(address,uint256); stores block.timestamp for user/collection
internal view calculateRewards(uint256,uint256); computes final reward and consumed boost from remaining boost/supply
internal setRewards(address,uint256); accrues time-weighted rewards, calls spaceCows.getMintingRate, mutates rewards and remaining supply/boost
external updateReward(address,address,uint256) guarded by isAllowAddress; settles rewards for from and to on transfers
external getReward(address,uint256) guarded by isAllowAddress; zeroes stored reward and mints tokens to the user
external burn(address,uint256,uint256) guarded by isAllowAddress; burns tokens from a user
external view getTotalClaimable(address,uint256); computes pending reward using block.timestamp and spaceCows rate
external onlyOwner setSpaceCowsAddress(address); sets the external SpaceCows contract
external onlyOwner setCollectionInfo(uint256,string,uint256,uint256); initializes caps for a collection
internal onlyOwner override _authorizeUpgrade(address); guards UUPS upgrade
msg.sender; used by isAllowAddress modifier and onlyOwner checks
block.timestamp; used to accrue time-based rewards and to stamp lastUpdate
_mint(msg.sender, 6182917500000000000000000) inside initialize; privileged supply creation
external call spaceCows.getMintingRate(_user) inside setRewards before rewards/remaining supply are updated
_mint(_to, reward) inside getReward; token issuance from stored reward balance
_burn(_from, _amount) inside burn; authorized burn of user tokens
external view call spaceCows.getMintingRate(_user) inside getTotalClaimable
_name string parameter of initialize
_symbol string parameter of initialize
_user address parameter of updateUserTimeOnMint/updateReward
_collection uint256 parameter used as collection index
_mintingAmount uint256 parameter of calculateRewards
_from address parameter of burn
_to address parameter of getReward
_amount uint256 parameter of burn
_nftContract address parameter of setSpaceCowsAddress
_collectionIndex uint256 parameter of setCollectionInfo
_boostCap uint256 parameter of setCollectionInfo
_hardCap uint256 parameter of setCollectionInfo
time = block.timestamp local variable in updateUserTimeOnMint/updateUserTime
mintingReward computed in setRewards from rate and elapsed time
finalReward returned by calculateRewards and credited in setRewards
boostSupply (removedBoost) returned by calculateRewards and subtracted from remaining boost
reward local variable read from rewards[_to][_collection] in getReward
mintingRate assigned from spaceCows.getMintingRate(_user) in setRewards
pendingRewards computed in getTotalClaimable
userTimer = lastUpdate[_user][_collection] in setRewards

updateUserTime writes the block.timestamp-derived value to lastUpdate

setRewards decreases remainingBoostByCollection[_collection]
setRewards decreases remainingSupplyByCollection[_collection]

calculateRewards produces removedBoost (boostSupply)
